mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate is a key determinant of risk-free rates.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level against 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 310 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 310, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 102.5) signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0 and INDPRO < 102.5, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 158000), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to robust labor market conditions.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the trigger condition, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1500, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain conditions support corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO level against 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level (GDPC1) below 22500 billion (2017 dollars) signals a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to economic weakness.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 22500, 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) and high CPIAUCSL (above 310) signals stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors flee equities.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 310, 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
